scope: Read-only validation of Football-Data.co.uk Nordic merged CSV files FIN.csv, NOR.csv and SWE.csv. No paid API, database or application code was used.

pinnacle_warning.summary: Provider says Pinnacle public API odds became unreliable and systematically stale from 2025-07-23, and Pinnacle was removed from market Max/Avg calculations.

source.licence_note: Files are publicly downloadable for quantitative testing, but the site states All Rights Reserved and no standard open-data licence was identified; use internally unless redistribution rights are confirmed.

pinnacle.risk: Do not use PSCH/PSCD/PSCA on or after 2025-07-23 as a trustworthy closing line. The provider states Pinnacle API odds became systematically stale and were excluded from Max/Avg calculations.

time_semantics.evidence: The merged CSV and Football-Data notes define kickoff time but provide no timezone name or UTC offset. No timezone conversion was performed in this validation.

recommended_ingestion_policy.missing_values: Preserve as NULL; never synthesize odds or results.
recommended_ingestion_policy.latest_season: Treat the maximum season in each file as a live partial snapshot, not a completed season.
recommended_ingestion_policy.pinnacle: Quarantine PSCH/PSCD/PSCA for matches dated 2025-07-23 or later. MaxCH/MaxCD/MaxCA and AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA are documented as excluding Pinnacle after the warning date.
recommended_ingestion_policy.provenance: Persist source URL, source SHA-256, HTTP Last-Modified/ETag and source row identity with every import batch.
recommended_ingestion_policy.source_strings: Trim leading/trailing whitespace for canonical comparison while retaining the raw source value.
recommended_ingestion_policy.time: Keep source Time with timezone_unknown=true until an authoritative timezone rule is established; do not assume UTC or local league time.
recommended_ingestion_policy.odds_anomaly: Quarantine Finland 2021-08-31 KTP vs Inter Turku AvgCA=1.75 because it exceeds MaxCA=1.29; do not auto-correct the value.
